semantics.snapshot_id: Opaque bridge-generated UUID for one transfer attempt; no digest validation.
semantics.accepted: Passes shape AND context-specific token/nonce/session/source/scope/transfer authority. Shape-valid envelopes can still be ignored.
semantics.timeout: Heartbeat timeout accepts a fresh nonce immediately; old nonce/session cannot revive. Exhausted snapshot delivery attempts impose 10 seconds of Hello backoff.
semantics.application_ack: Only exact current session/revision/snapshot_id and completely sent transfer can advance applied_revision; chunk ack loss alone does not invalidate application acknowledgment.
semantics.heartbeat_ack: Only a current-session emitted current positive sequence, newer than the last acknowledged sequence, extends transport liveness.
semantics.nonce_replay: Initial saved nonces may repeat. Pending fresh bridge challenges are bounded to8 and expire after10 wall-clock seconds. Only confirmation of challenge UUID as final hello_nonce establishes authority.4096 confirmed final nonce SHA256 digests persist for service lifetime without eviction; current final retries remain idempotent. Issuance order prevents old final confirmations replacing newer confirmed authority. Restart bridge at history cap.
semantics.control_budget: Hello acceptance reserves required heartbeat overhead including populated UTC timestamps, numeric fields and at most 64 characters of error label. A shape-valid Hello can be ignored when this mandatory control budget cannot fit 1024 UTF-8 bytes. An individual session serialization failure invalidates that session without terminating delivery service.
semantics.handshake: hello(initial) -> hello_challenge(fresh bridge UUID, echoed initial nonce, null session) -> hello(final nonce=challenge UUID, challenge_id) -> hello_ack(fresh session, echoed final nonce). Initial/challenge do not bind source or refresh source.
semantics.recovery_verification: Reset on every handshake/load/resume. Accept snapshots and ack heartbeats immediately; verified source health requires four distinct strictly increasing current-session heartbeat sequences and latest source_ok/source_read_at matching accepted snapshot. Up to20seconds at5second cadence. Trusted localhost buffering model, not adversarial replay authenticity; current-final retries do not extend15second bridge liveness.
